description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1439/29 of 02.03.2006 - Diulapitiya D/S Division, - Cad. Map No. 510083
categorisation: This gazette exclusively deals with land title registration matters. It contains an amendment to the Registration of Title Act regarding a specific parcel of land (No. 134 of Block 02) in the Gampaha District, detailing changes to the land title register by inserting a servitude right. The content focuses entirely on land property matters, specifically title registration and encumbrances, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There is no mention of government personnel, structural changes, or any other specialized category that would take precedence.
